app.name: Cage
app.tagline: Someone is watching over every trip

checkIn.question: Are you safe?
checkIn.noAnswer: If you don't answer, Cage will alert your safety circle.

circle.name: Safety circle

onboarding.title: Who should we tell?
onboarding.body: Pick at least 2 people. They don't need Cage; alerts reach them by SMS and Zalo.

circle.empty: No one yet. Add people you trust, like family or a close friend.
circle.nudge: Add one more person, ideally somewhere else, in case the first one doesn't answer.
circle.order: People at the top are told first.
circle.removeBody: {{name}} won't be told anymore. Any trip link they were sent stops working.

ladder.heading: If no one answers in {{minutes}}
ladder.policeBody: Off for now; you can turn it on in Settings

errors.load: Couldn't load your safety circle. Check your connection and try again.
errors.error: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
errors.invalid_phone: That phone number doesn't look right. Please check it.
errors.own_number: That's your own number. Enter someone else's.
errors.circle_full: Your safety circle already has {{max}} people. Remove one to add another.

permission.title: Pick people from contacts
permission.body: Your phone will ask to let Cage see your contacts.
permission.onlyPicked: Cage only keeps the people you pick
permission.noUpload: Your contact list is never uploaded
permission.quiet: The people you pick hear nothing until something goes wrong
permission.denied: Cage can't see your contacts. You can still enter a number.

picker.title: Pick from contacts
picker.empty: No contacts with a phone number.
picker.loadError: Couldn't read your contacts. You can still enter a number.
picker.full: You've picked the most you can add ({{max}}).

manual.title: Enter a phone number
manual.body: They get messages by SMS and Zalo and don't need Cage.
manual.name: Name

web.linkStops: This link stops sharing when {{name}} arrives
web.linkEnded: This trip has ended. The link no longer shares location.
web.liveNote: Cage will tell you straight away if {{name}} goes off route or doesn't answer a check-in call.
web.checkInTitle: Cage is asking {{name}} if they're safe
web.checkInBody: You don't need to do anything yet. Cage will tell you if {{name}} doesn't answer.
web.checkInAlertAt: {{time}} · The whole circle is told if {{name}} hasn't answered
web.alertBody: {{name}}'s location is still updating. The whole circle was told at {{time}}.
web.duressBody: On {{name}}'s phone everything looks normal. Someone may be watching {{name}}.
web.messageFirstWhy: A stranger may be next to {{name}}.
web.doNotContactWhy: Someone next to them may see it.
web.lostBatteryTitle: {{name}}'s phone probably ran out of battery
web.lostBody: Last seen at {{time}} with {{battery}} battery. {{name}} was expected to arrive at {{arrival}}.
web.lostBodyNoUpdate: Cage hasn't received a location yet. {{name}} was expected to arrive at {{arrival}}.
web.lostNoPolice: Cage never tells the police or a hotline about lost contact alone.

phone.title: Your phone number
phone.body: Cage sends a 6-digit code to confirm it. No password or email.
phone.label: Phone number
phone.noCageBody: It looks like any verification code.
phone.onceBody: Cage won't ask again after this.
phone.circleTitle: Your people don't need an account
phone.circleBody: They get messages by SMS and Zalo.

errors.invalid: That number doesn't look right. Please check it.
errors.too_many: This number has had a lot of codes. Try again in an hour.
errors.error: Couldn't send the code. Check your connection and try again.

errors.wrong: That code isn't right. Try again or get a new code.
errors.too_many: Too many tries. Wait a few minutes and try again.
errors.error: Couldn't connect. Check your connection and try again.

welcomeBack.title: Welcome back
welcomeBack.body: {{phone}} has used Cage before. Your settings are now on this phone.
welcomeBack.permissions: You only need to allow permissions again on this phone.

codes.enter: Enter 4 digits, then again to confirm
codes.confirm: Enter the 4 digits again to confirm

safe.title: Set your safe code
safe.body: Use this code to say you're OK, in the app and when Cage calls to check in.

duress.title: Set your duress code
duress.body: If someone forces you to answer, enter this code. Cage will look normal but quietly alert your safety circle.
duress.hint: Make it differ from your safe code in at least 2 digits, and easy to remember even when you're scared.

errors.too_simple: That code is too easy to guess. Choose 4 other digits.
errors.too_close: The duress code must differ from the safe code in at least 2 digits.
errors.mismatch: The two entries don't match. Start again.
errors.error: Couldn't save the codes. Check your connection and try again.
errors.journey_open: You have a journey in progress. Reset your codes after it ends.

reset.title: Reset your codes
reset.body: Cage sends a 6-digit code to {{phone}} to check it's you. Then you set a new safe code and duress code.
reset.journeyNote: You can't reset during a journey. If you forget your code mid-journey, let the time run out and Cage will tell your safety circle.
reset.oldCodesNote: Your old codes will stop working.

messages.code: Your verification code is {{code}}. Don't share it with anyone.
messages.journeyStarted: {{name}} just started a trip to {{destination}}, expected to arrive at {{time}}. Follow at {{url}}

alert.no_answer: {{name}} didn't answer the check-in call. See their live location at {{url}}. Message first, don't call yet.
alert.duress: {{name}} just entered their emergency code. See their live location at {{url}}. Don't call or message {{name}}: someone next to them may see it.
alert.sos: {{name}} just pressed SOS. See their live location at {{url}}. Message first, don't call yet.
alert.lost_contact: Cage lost contact with {{name}} after their expected arrival time. See their last location at {{url}}

messages.safeNow: {{name}} confirmed they're safe with their safe code. You don't need to do anything else.

demo.band: Separate demo server · Messages are only logged, never sent · No real calls
demo.title: Demo dashboard
demo.locked: Too many wrong tries. Try again in 15 minutes.
demo.off: This server doesn't have the demo switched on.
demo.safe1: The real server has no such page.
demo.safe2: Messages to the safety circle are only logged.
demo.safe3: Only numbers on the demo list show up here.
demo.safe4: The safe code and the emergency code are only typed on the phone.
demo.pickBody: Start a trip in the app on the phone first. Anyone on a trip shows up here.
demo.nobody: Nobody is on a trip yet.
demo.chipCheckIn: Check-in call · waiting for an answer {{time}}
demo.restartConfirm: Delete this trip? The account and safety circle stay.
demo.routeNote: Replaces the phone's GPS · sent every 3 seconds
demo.routeOffNote: stopped where they left the route
demo.stateSafeBodyAlert: Only the safe code, typed on the phone, brings this back.
demo.stateCallBodyAlert: Not available once the safety circle has been told.
demo.stateDangerBody: The safety circle is told; messages are only logged.
demo.stateDangerDuress: Emergency code typed on the phone. The safety circle was told quietly.
demo.logSkip: Dashboard skips the time to answer
demo.logQuiet: Dashboard makes the phone go quiet
demo.circleNote: The safety circle's real page. Refreshes every 3 seconds.
demo.gone: This trip has ended or was deleted.
demo.callsOff: Demo: call and message buttons are off

plan.title: Where are you going?
plan.destinationHint: For example: Bờ Sông guesthouse, District 1
plan.checkNote: If something looks wrong, Cage will ask you
plan.checkNoteBody: No answer in 60 seconds and your circle is told
plan.notFound: Couldn't find that address. Try adding more, like the district.
plan.needLocation: Cage needs your location so your circle can see you during the trip.
plan.error: Couldn't start. Check your connection and try again.

onRoute.sharing: Your circle sees your location until you end the trip.

ask.body: If you're OK, enter your code to carry on. If you need help, alert now.
ask.autoAlert: When time runs out, your circle is told.

enterCode.title: Enter your code
enterCode.body: The 4-digit code you set when you installed Cage.
enterCode.endBody: Enter your 4-digit code. Your circle will stop seeing your location.
enterCode.forgot: Forgot your code? Let the time run out and Cage will tell your circle.

alerted.title: Your circle has been told
alerted.body: Sent at {{time}}. They see your location until you're safe.
alerted.lostBody: Your circle has been told. They see your last location.

arrived.title: Your trip has ended
arrived.body: Your circle no longer sees your location.
